conversation_id.description: Leer lassen für eine neue Konversation
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

password.description: IMAP app password (e.g. iCloud/Yahoo app-specific password). Exactly one of password / password_secret.
password.title: Password

password_secret.description: Name of a Mistral workspace secret holding the app password (lowercase, e.g. 'yahoo-app-password') — one secret per account. Only the reference is stored.
password_secret.title: Password Secret

get.description:
The app's status and each dependency's: whether Mistral is configured, whether each checked
service answers. ``degraded`` when one does not; the response is 200 either way.

post.description:
Send one chat message to the mail agent and return the messages it produced.

Pass an empty ``conversation_id`` to start a new conversation; the response returns the
conversation id to continue with. The agent may create a pending draft, but this operation
never sends a mail by itself.
post.summary: Send a message to the mail agent

get.description: List all chat conversations, most recently updated first.
get.summary: List all chat conversations, newest first

delete.description:
Discard a pending draft without sending it — no mail is delivered.

``draft_id`` identifies the draft chat message; it answers 404 when the id is not a draft
and 409 when the draft was already handled (sent, failed or cancelled). The returned message
carries the draft with status ``cancelled``.

post.description:
Send the pending draft for real; this is the only path that actually sends a mail.

``draft_id`` identifies the pending draft chat message, which is sent to its recipients via
the account that created it. On success the draft is stored with status ``sent`` and the
provider's send result; a send failure stores status ``failed`` with a safe error code.
Blocked hosts answer 422 and other send failures 502. Unknown or already handled
drafts answer 404 and 409.
post.summary: Send the confirmed draft for real

get.description:
Return every message of one conversation in conversation order.

``conversation_id`` selects the conversation; an unknown id answers 404.
get.summary: All messages of one conversation, in order

get.description:
List all connected mail accounts with provider, auth type and e-mail address.

Credentials are never part of the response.

post.description:
Connect an IMAP/SMTP account with an app password and store its credentials encrypted.

Exactly one of ``password`` or ``password_secret`` is required; ``password_secret`` names a
workspace secret (for example ``yahoo-app-password``) whose value is resolved now and re-read
at runtime, so only the reference is stored. Server hosts must be allow-listed and the IMAP
login is checked before the account is created; answers 201 with the new account.
An address already using another connection type answers 409 without changing credentials.

get.description:
Start the OAuth2 flow for ``google`` or ``microsoft`` and return the URL to open in a browser.

The response carries the ``authorization_url`` plus the signed ``state`` that the provider
echoes back to the callback; nothing is redirected here. Answers 503 when that provider's
OAuth client is not configured.
get.summary: Start the OAuth2 flow for google or microsoft; open the returned URL in the browser

get.description:
OAuth2 redirect target: exchange the authorization code and store the encrypted tokens.

The signed ``state`` must match ``provider``; the provider's e-mail address decides which
mail account is created or updated (auth type ``oauth2``) and returned.
An address already using another connection type answers 409 without changing credentials.
get.summary: OAuth2 redirect target: exchanges the code and stores the encrypted tokens

delete.description:
Delete a mail account together with its credentials, synced messages and sync state.

``account_id`` selects the account; the data cannot be restored. Answers 204 on success and
404 for an unknown account.
delete.summary: Delete an account and all its data

post.description: Schedule a sync for an existing account, deduplicating open jobs.
Undo up to 200 actions, newest first, within 24 hours; report individual failures.

get.description:
List the Mistral Studio connectors of this workspace as ``name``/``id`` pairs.

These are the connectors that can be registered as a mail account.
get.summary: List the workspace's Mistral Studio connectors

post.description:
Register a Studio connector such as ``gmail`` as a mail account and return it.

The connector keeps the OAuth credentials inside Mistral, so the app stores no secret; the
account's e-mail address is derived from a one-message ``search_threads`` call when the
connector offers that tool and otherwise stays a placeholder. Answers 201.
post.summary: Connect a Studio connector (e.g. gmail) as a mail account

get.description:
List the tools of one Studio connector with name, description and input schema.

``name`` is the connector name; an unknown connector answers 404.
List messages with filters and an opaque cursor for the next page.
Return one indexed message or 404 if it does not exist.
get.summary: Read one synced message in full

post.description: Update one message at its provider and retain its previous state for 24-hour undo.

get.description: Return the cached insight or generate it for this message.
Return unread inbox counts and sync status for all connected accounts.

post.description: Queue active accounts, optionally only those last synced before the given age.
